extracted.intended_audience: journalists, researchers, policymakers, and members of the public seeking AEI scholars or expertise
extracted.subtask_description: An institutional 'Our Scholars' page listing AEI scholars and describing the organizational values and standards that guide scholars' work and public presentation. Useful for finding scholars by policy area and understanding AEI's commitments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to AEI's mission
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI scholars are committed to making the intellectual, moral, and practical case for expanding freedom, increasing individual opportunity, and strengthening the free enterprise system in America and around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states scholars' work 'explores ideas that further these goals' and that scholars 'take part in this pursuit'—implying work should be oriented toward advancing those specific themes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Academic freedom for scholars
rubrics_metrics.description: Our work explores ideas that further these goals, and AEI scholars take part in this pursuit with academic freedom.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: AEI emphasizes that scholars operate with academic freedom when producing research and commentary, indicating tolerance for a range of viewpoints aligned with scholarly inquiry rather than enforced institutional positions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organizational independence / no institutional positions
rubrics_metrics.description: AEI operates independently of any political party and has no institutional positions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a stated institutional constraint: AEI presents itself as nonpartisan at the organizational level, so individual scholars' outputs are not institutional positions and the organization disclaims formal affiliation with parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence- and data-driven conclusions
rubrics_metrics.description: Our scholars’ conclusions are fueled by rigorous, data-driven research and broad-ranging evidence.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page positions rigor and empirical support as central evaluative criteria for scholars' work—emphasizing methodological rigor, use of data, and consideration of wide-ranging evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organization by policy area
rubrics_metrics.description: Find a scholar by policy area: (lists such as Agricultural Policy Studies, Economics, Education, Foreign and Defense Policy, Health Care, Housing, Legal and Constitutional, Opportunity and Social Mobility, Politics and Public Opinion, Society and Culture, Technology, Science, and Energy).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Scholars are presented and discoverable by discrete policy-area categories, implying that subject-matter alignment is a primary organizing principle for locating expertise.
